title: RDS Instance Publicly Accessible

title: IAM inline policy does not allow privilege escalation
llm_guidance:
The IAM inline policy attached to the role allows privilege escalation by granting excessive permissions, which can lead to unintended access and potential security risks.
To remediate this issue, update the IAM inline policy to only include the specific actions and resources required by the workload, and avoid granting broad permissions such as 'iam:*' and 'iam:PassRole'.

title: SQL Server Firewall Allows All IPs
llm_guidance:
Azure SQL Database firewall rules should allow access only to specific IP ranges, preventing unrestricted access to the database.
Update the Azure SQL Database firewall rule to restrict access to the specific IP range by editing the rule 'MISCONFIG-AllowAllIPs' and replacing the current IP range with the allowed IP range.

title: EC2 instance does not allow ingress from the Internet to TCP port 22 (SSH)
llm_guidance:
SSH access to the EC2 instance is exposed to the entire internet, posing a significant risk to the security of the instance and the data it contains.
To remediate this issue, update the security group rule for the public subnet to only allow SSH traffic from a specific known IP address or a VPN CIDR range, and ensure that the bastion host is configured to allow SSH access to the instance.

title: Storage Account Reachable From Any Network
llm_guidance:
Azure Storage accounts are accessible from any network, posing a high risk to data exposure.
Update the Azure Storage account configuration to set 'allowBlobPublicAccess' to 'false' and restrict public access to individual containers only when explicitly required.

title: Storage Account Allows Public Blob Access
llm_guidance:
Azure Storage account with public blob access enabled poses a risk of unauthorized data access.
Disable public blob access at the Azure Storage account level by setting allowBlobPublicAccess to false in the Azure portal or using Azure CLI/PowerShell with the command az storage account update --name <account_name> --resource-group <resource_group_name> --set tags.allowBlobPublicAccess=false.
